task.title: Updating read-only expiration time
task.shortdesc: To extend the lifetime of a Red Hat Quay read-only service key, you can update the key expiration date in the PostgreSQL database.

context.p: The Red Hat Quay read-only key has an expiration date, and when that date passes the key is deactivated. Before the key expires, you can update its expiration time in the database.

step.cmd: Connect to your Red Hat Quay production database by using the methods described earlier.
Optional. List service key IDs by running the following query:

info.codeblock: SELECT id, name, expiration_date FROM servicekey;

step.cmd: Update the key expiration by issuing the following query:

info.codeblock: quay=# UPDATE servicekey SET expiration_date = 'new-date' WHERE id = servicekey_id;
